adaptation: At least four real supplier-review agents run concurrent multi-review batches in separate sandboxes over one persistent operations store. V15 joins the first three incident components in one empty-start campaign. A normal source-resolution diagnostic can create a method-free agent-authored probe. Real submissions create method-redacted receipts that identify live jobs solving the same blocker class. Manual writes to the same directory remain undocumented. The primary gate requires a different agent to read an exact probe and live capability receipt, initiate a help request, receive a working method reply from that capable peer, and have a fresh fourth agent read and use the reply while all four execution intervals overlap.
